headline: Hurricane Isaias slams Gulf refining as diesel prices stay near records
intro: Mother Nature and geopolitics are tag-teaming the fuels market this week — a Cat 3 hurricane just took a third of Gulf platforms offline while Ukraine keeps lighting up Russian refineries, and somehow diesel still can't catch a break at the pump.
overview: Hurricane Isaias strengthened to Category 3 and shut in roughly 1.3M bpd of Gulf production and 121 platforms, putting Gulf Coast refineries on alert even as crude eased Friday on hopes of easing Iran tensions and fuel export resumption. Diesel remains stubbornly elevated near record highs despite White House efforts to boost supply, while independent refiners are set for another blowout earnings quarter on tight global refined product supply. On the policy and clean-fuels side, leadership shakeups hit EcoEngineers and LanzaJet, the Clean Fuel Credit Consortium weighed in on 45Z chain-of-custody rules, and Couche-Tard moved to acquire Irving Oil retail assets in Quebec and Ontario.

stories.title: Hurricane Isaias squeezes Gulf oil output and puts key refineries on alert
stories.summary: Hurricane Isaias shut in 1.3M bpd of Gulf production and put key refineries on alert, with US refining already running near capacity.

stories.title: 121 Gulf Platforms Evacuated as Isaias Gets Stronger
stories.summary: 121 of the Gulf's 371 manned platforms — 32.6% — were evacuated as Isaias intensified.

stories.title: Nymex Overview: Oil Edges Higher; Hurricane Isaias in Focus -- OPIS
stories.summary: Oil edged higher as Hurricane Isaias, now a major hurricane, shut in offshore production and threatened two Gulf Coast refineries.

stories.title: Oil Eases on Fuel Export Resumption, Trump Iran Comments
stories.summary: Oil prices slid Friday after Trump touted "productive discussions" with Iran and said he won't order attacks ahead of the midterms, aided by fuel export resumption.

stories.title: Trump’s moves to boost diesel supplies have not yet lowered prices
stories.summary: US diesel prices remain near record highs, up 70% since the Iran conflict began, despite two Trump administration moves aimed at boosting diesel supply.

stories.title: U.S. refining giants rake in "war dividends": Q3 profits poised to set another record as three companies add $224 billion in market value this year
stories.summary: US independent refiners are poised for record Q3 profits as tightening global refined product supply drives a historic earnings cycle; three companies have added $224B in market value this year.

stories.title: Dallas Fed: Refinery constraints could keep fuel prices higher
stories.summary: A Dallas Fed report finds continued refinery constraints could keep fuel prices elevated.

stories.title: Mizuho raises target for Valero Energy stock to USD 434
stories.summary: Mizuho raised its Valero price target from $300 to $434, citing Q2 revenue of $44.48B, up nearly 49% year-over-year.

stories.title: Alimentation Couche-Tard To Buy Irving Oil Retail Assets In Québec, Ontario
stories.summary: Alimentation Couche-Tard agreed to acquire Irving Oil retail assets in Quebec and Ontario, including 50 retail sites.

stories.title: Ohio’s gas-tax holiday comes with a $725 million state backfill for roads
stories.summary: Ohio cut gasoline and diesel taxes to near zero for 90 days, backfilling $725 million from the General Revenue Fund to cover lost transportation funding.

stories.title: Clean Fuel Credit Consortium publishes reading of 45Z chain-of-custody rules
stories.summary: The Clean Fuel Credit Consortium published its reading of 45Z chain-of-custody rules, concluding mass-balance books belong with the grain's owner.

stories.title: Samartzis to step down as LanzaJet CEO
stories.summary: LanzaJet founding CEO Jimmy Samartzis is stepping down to take a new leadership role in the SAF industry.

stories.title: Menon, founder of EcoEngineers, steps back as CEO to begin new chapter
stories.summary: EcoEngineers founder and CEO Shashi Menon is taking a yearlong sabbatical, stepping back from the role.

stories.title: US seizes 90 biodiesel shipments bound for Cuba
stories.summary: US authorities seized 90 biodiesel shipments worth over $2.8 million, containing more than 600,000 gallons, bound for Cuba.
